title: GazeForge: Auditable AI for Eye-Tracking Analysis
description: GazeForge is vendor-neutral Python research software for auditable AI-assisted eye-tracking analysis. It provides machine-learning-assisted quality control, transparent and learned eye-event modelling, semantic and dynamic AOIs with human review, scanpath representations, participant-held-out and dataset-held-out validation, calibration diagnostics, deterministic provenance, and frozen benchmark evidence. Version 0.1.0a1 is the first public alpha release. It includes the reviewed Lund2013 external evidence suite and the provenance/rights infrastructure developed for additional external benchmarks. This alpha release does not claim native 60 Hz/GP3 device validation, completed Gaze-in-the-Wild model or human-agreement evidence, completed VISUS/Hollywood2 empirical validation, or stable API guarantees.
